components.navbar: Fixed header. Default transparent, on scroll shifts to bg-[#080808]/90 with backdrop-blur-md and border-b border-white/10. Shrinks padding on scroll. Mobile uses hamburger menu.
components.hero: Min-h-screen. Uses the hero image with an overlay of bg-gradient-to-r from-[#080808]/90 via-[#080808]/50 to-transparent to ensure text readability.
components.service_cards: Dark background (#111111), 1px solid border-white/5, subtle gold glow on hover (hover:border-[#C9A84C]/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(201,168,76,0.1)]). Image at the top fixed at h-[220px] object-cover. Contains duration tabs and pricing.
components.service_modal: Shadcn Dialog component. Dark background, contains an image slider, benefits list, products used, and what to expect.
components.premium_services: Larger 2-column cards, rich gold accents, elegant typography to differentiate from regular services.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#C9A84C] text-[#080808] hover:bg-[#E1C068] transition-colors. Outline: border border-[#C9A84C] text-[#C9A84C] hover:bg-[#C9A84C]/10.
components.floating_actions: WhatsApp floating button on bottom-right with an infinite pulse animation using #25D366. Call button floating on bottom-left with gold outline.
components.mobile_sticky_bar: Sticky fixed bar at the bottom of the screen on mobile devices containing quick CTAs (Book Now, Call).
components.why_choose_us: 6 feature cards with minimal icons, text-cream, and gold accent for icons.
components.gallery: Bento or masonry grid of 6 images with hover scale effects.
components.testimonials: Cards with deep charcoal background (#111111), gold star ratings, and user avatars.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts: 'Playfair Display' for headings and 'DM Sans' for body text.
Extend Tailwind configuration with the custom colors defined in this JSON.
Implement smooth scrolling using CSS scroll-behavior: smooth or Lenis.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, links, modals, form inputs).
Implement the Service Modals using Shadcn UI's Dialog primitive. Add a simple image slider mechanism inside.
Create a pulsing animation in Tailwind (keyframes pulse-glow) for the WhatsApp floating button.
Ensure mobile responsiveness: hamburger menu for navbar and sticky bottom bar with quick action buttons.
Use standard <a> or <button> tags with appropriate hrefs for the Contact and Google Map sections.
